mobilebase.creative_only: Assembly and disassembly are available in Creative mode in this prototype.
mobilebase.launch_hint: Use the core with an empty hand to preview, then use it again within 10 seconds to assemble.
mobilebase.launch_preview: %s hull + %s parts (%s kg). Use again to launch.
mobilebase.launched: Boat assembled. Fuel the engine and use the helm.
mobilebase.use_core: Preview and confirm safe disassembly at the core.
mobilebase.park: Anchor requested. Leave the boat before docking.
mobilebase.dock_preview: %s landing blocks in blue. Use again to dock.
mobilebase.docked: Boat docked. Edit the structure and use the core again to preview reassembly.
mobilebase.error.boundary: Hull too large or attached. Leave a clear gap.
mobilebase.error.unloaded: The area contains unloaded chunks or is outside build height.
mobilebase.error.unsupported: This prototype cannot safely move the block at %s.
mobilebase.error.helm_space: Leave two walkable deck squares behind the helm.
mobilebase.error.deck_space: No clear deck position to install the remaining part.
mobilebase.error.anchor: Leave one clear deck position immediately to the right of the core for its unpowered anchor.
mobilebase.error.water: Launch requires water deep enough below at least one hull column.
mobilebase.error.floater_space: There is not enough space for floaters on both sides of the hull.
mobilebase.error.mass: Cannot determine a valid mass for this hull.
mobilebase.error.entity: An entity occupies an installation position.
mobilebase.error.foreign_ship: This ship was assembled outside the Mobile Base Assembler.
mobilebase.error.not_stopped: Sneak-use the core to anchor. Wait until cruise has stopped and the boat is still.
mobilebase.error.alignment: Release anchor and align with the Eureka helm.
mobilebase.error.aboard: All players, dropped items, and animals must leave the boat before disassembly.
mobilebase.error.occupied: The destination is out of bounds, unloaded, or occupied by another ship.
mobilebase.error.occupied_at: The landing block at %s is occupied or cannot be safely replaced.
mobilebase.error.dock_size: The ship has unloaded chunks, an unexpected core count, or too many blocks.
mobilebase.error.rolled_back: Relocation failed its checks. Blocks and saved data were restored. See the server log.
mobilebase.marker.heading: Heading
mobilebase.marker.surface: Mark the face of a structural block.
mobilebase.adapted_preview: %s hull + %s parts (%s kg). Adaptive setup. Use again to launch.
mobilebase.adapted_launched: Adaptive boat ready. Fuel the engine before driving.
mobilebase.error.marked_helm: Marked helm needs a connected clear deck and room to sit and exit.
mobilebase.error.marked_engine: Marked engine conflicts with the build or the driver’s space.
mobilebase.error.marked_floater: Mark an open cell under the hull at the waterline.
mobilebase.error.marked_installed: A matching component is already installed. Clear the mark or move the existing component first.
mobilebase.error.marker_in_world: Use the marker on a core before assembly.
